description: This file defines the main coordinator class PeekabooBridgeHostCoordinator for managing a bridge host in a macOS application, including socket management, starting/stopping services, and security features. It also includes a service class OpenClawPeekabooBridgeServices initializing various subsystem services.

classes.name: PeekabooBridgeHostCoordinator
classes.description: Main actor class coordinating the Peekaboo bridge host lifecycle, socket management, and security features.

classes.name: OpenClawPeekabooBridgeServices
classes.description: Provides various subsystem services such as permissions, window management, automation, and application control.

methods.name: setEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables the bridge host by starting or stopping services.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the host if it is running, resets internal state.

methods.name: startIfNeeded
methods.description: Initializes and starts the host if not already running, including setting up socket paths and creating server instances.

methods.name: ensureLegacySocketSymlinks
methods.description: Ensures legacy socket symlink paths are correctly linked to the current socket path.

methods.name: ensureLegacySocketSymlink
methods.description: Creates or updates a symbolic link for legacy socket paths.

methods.name: currentTeamID
methods.description: Retrieves the current code signing team identifier for security purposes.
